sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 52804 of 2023

Applicant :- Malti Devi
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Avinash Mani Tripathi,Prashant Kumar Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Noor Muhammad,Yogesh Kumar Srivastava
Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.

The information of mentioning the case is said to have been given to the learned counsel for the first informant by the learned counsel for the applicant but no one has put in appearance on behalf of first informant.
The mention slip filed by the learned counsel for the applicant is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

This application has been moved by applicant Malti Devi to enlarge her on bail in Case Crime No.
421 of 2023 under Sections 147, 307, 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Ramgarh, District Firozabad.
It is argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that it is a case of attempt to suicide.
The applicant lives separately and as soon as she reached the spot she saved the victim and took her to a private hospital where the family members of the victim also came.
The father in law of the alleged victim has been granted anticipatory bail by the coordinate bench of this court.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 29.09.2023, hence, the prayer for bail is made.

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. however opposed the prayer for bail.
From perusal of the record, it is found that as per first information report, the role assigned to the applicant is general in nature.
The present applicant along with all the co-accused persons is said to have hurled abuses and thrashed the victim with fists, blows, batons and sticks.

In the statement of the victim under Section 161 Cr.P.C. also she has assigned the specific role of alleged hanging and attempt to murder to her husband, mother-in-law Malti Devi, father-in-law Satya Prakash,
brother-in-law Kishan and sister-in-law (jethani) Omwati.
The father-in-law Satya Prakash has been granted anticipatory bail by the coordinate bench of this court.
As per the record, it is admitted fact that in the private hospital the victim was taken for treatment by her in-laws.
As per medical report appended at page 37 of the paper book, three injuries; one ligature mark on her neck along with two abrasions on cheek and forearm of the victim respectively were found.
Co-accused Satya Prakash having identical role has been granted anticipatory bail by the coordinate bench of this court.
The bail application of the husband of the victim is said to have been rejected.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 29.09.2023.

Perusing the record, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the nature of allegations,
arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I find it to be a fit case for granting bail to the applicant.
The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant Malti Devi involved in the aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing personal bonds and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to the following conditions:-
1. The applicant will attend and co-operate the trial proceedings pending before the court concerned on the date fixed after release.
2. She will not tamper with the witnesses.
3. She will not indulge in any illegal activities during the bail period.

The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by the court concerned and in case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court below shall be at liberty to cancel the bail and send the applicant to prison.

It is clarified that the observations, if any, made in this order are strictly confined to the disposal of this bail application and must not be construed to have any reflection on the ultimate merits of the case.
